---
title: "Membership"
---

Membership is open to any person who has a relevant advanced academic degree (Ph.D. or its equivalent) and who is active in the field of Judgment and Decision Making. A Ph.D. student in any field who has an interest in Judgment and Decision Making may become a Student Member during his/her study, for a maximum period of four years.

Members pay a reduced SPUDM conference fee, which is linked to the membership fees.

<strong>Becoming or extending EADM membership regularly can be done during the registration to SPUDM (once every two years)!</strong>

Currently, the only way to become EADM member is in the context of a SPUDM conference (i.e., via membership registration on an upcoming SPUDM conference web page).
